env_allowlist.PATH: runner-provided command discovery; every material executable used by the narrow replay is content-hash checked

network_enforcement: Every Lean invocation runs with --trust=0 inside bubblewrap --unshare-net. The host root is read-only and only a fresh temporary target-module directory is writable. The existing pinned shared dependency cache is reused read-only, so this is expressly nonrelease evidence.
scope_boundary: Reconciles the frozen 16-obligation inventory and current authority, then replays only the conditional branch merge, the three converse proof declarations, and four separately written converse or conditional-root declarations. It does not provide NecessityTerminal, close M1026-T-NECESSITY or the exact root, make the stale predecessor recipe current, accept any receipt, or supply H0, R0, AUDIT-Z, cold/offline release evidence, independent verification, THEOREM-Z, release, or master acceptance.
